checks.detail: AC-019-01: SSE streaming emits accepted, delta, citation, and completed events with lecture-grounded citations
AC-019-02: Privacy guard blocks cross-course and draft documents, scoping citations only to pinned sourceRefs
AC-019-03: Message deduplication via clientMessageId and run recovery via GET /runs/:runId verified
AC-020-01: Server-side grading evaluates checkpoint attempts; client cannot spoof mastery flag
AC-020-02: LessonProgress provenance records progress status, score, and passedCheckpoints linked to sourceSessionId
AC-020-03: Duplicate checkpoint attempts are deduplicated idempotently without corrupting attempt counts
AC-021-01: Finish session triggers classroom.session.finished outbox event and generates deterministic SessionSummary with inputHash
AC-021-02: Summary access strictly gated to session owner (outsiders return 404); failed summary status preserves completed session
AC-021-03: Async summary worker retry and promptVersion update are idempotent without transcript or summary duplication
